reasons.app:info: Electron glue: reads app.getVersion() and the running process, which only the packaged app has
reasons.settings:setComfyKey: safeStorage: seals the Comfy.org key with the OS key store before it is written
reasons.settings:setCivitaiKey: safeStorage: seals the Civitai key with the OS key store before it is written
reasons.settings:set: Electron glue: main's settings filter holds the secret fields back from the window and applies the rest to the running app
reasons.hardware:apply: Electron glue: writes the first-run choices into the running app's settings
reasons.comfy:launcher: Electron glue: reads the launchers on this machine and the ComfyUI start state main holds
reasons.comfy:chooseLauncher: native dialog: asks for the ComfyUI launcher with an open dialog
reasons.comfy:chooseFolder: native dialog: asks for the person's ComfyUI folder with an open dialog
reasons.folders:videos: Electron glue: videosState() is main's closure over the app's video folder
reasons.folders:chooseVideos: native dialog: asks where finished videos go with an open dialog
reasons.folders:resetVideos: Electron glue: videosState() is main's closure over the app's video folder
reasons.data:choose: native dialog: asks where to move the data folder with an open dialog
reasons.data:open: shell open: shell.openPath opens the data folder in the system's file manager
reasons.data:restart: window state: relaunches and exits the real app
reasons.agents:info: Electron glue: main's skill file path and the app's own MCP command, under the person's home
reasons.agents:installSkill: Electron glue: writes the agent skill file into the person's home from main's path
reasons.learn:openGuide: shell open: copies the bundled guide PDF and opens it with the system viewer
reasons.links:open: shell open: shell.openExternal opens the link in the default browser
reasons.files:reveal: shell open: shell.showItemInFolder shows the file in the system's file manager
reasons.update:state: Electron glue: the packaged app's updater state held in main
reasons.update:check: Electron glue: asks the packaged app's updater, which a test run does not have
reasons.update:install: Electron glue: installs through the packaged app's updater after main checks nothing is running
reasons.incognito:set: Electron glue: switches the running app's incognito mode, which main holds
reasons.music:pickSong: native dialog: asks for a song with an open dialog
reasons.music:toEdit: Electron glue: putOnEdit is main's closure that puts a file on the open edit
reasons.images:toEdit: Electron glue: putOnEdit is main's closure that puts a file on the open edit
reasons.files:pick: native dialog: asks for a picture, video or sound with an open dialog
reasons.library:all: Electron glue: main joins the Studio, edit and music lists in a closure
reasons.library:toEdit: Electron glue: putOnEdit is main's closure that puts a file on the open edit
reasons.shinobi:saveBrief: Electron glue: writes the brief into main's Shinobi project folder
reasons.shinobi:addToEdit: Electron glue: editWith is main's closure that puts a cut on an edit
reasons.rebuild:pickVideo: native dialog: asks for a video with an open dialog
reasons.replace:toEdit: Electron glue: editWith is main's closure that puts a file on an edit
reasons.training:chooseFizgig: native dialog: asks for Fizgig's folder with an open dialog
reasons.window:fullScreen: window state: sets the real window's full screen
reasons.cloud:status: safeStorage: reports which cloud tokens are saved by reading the OS key store
reasons.cloud:provider: Electron glue: main's check that rendering is not on the cloud before it switches provider
reasons.cloud:clearToken: safeStorage: clears a sealed cloud token, reading the OS key store for which are saved
reasons.projects:list: Electron glue: main's projection of the Studio's projects for the window
reasons.jobs:watch: Electron glue: main's pending set and its pump, which send job events to the window
reasons.edits:changed: window state: main sends it to the window when an edit changes; only a window receives it
reasons.update:changed: Electron glue: sent by the packaged app's updater to the window
